cartoonforge presents

Cartoons, drawn entirely in code.

Pick a classic animation style, write a few lines, and get a vertical reel with voice, music and captions. No video model, no animator — every frame is drawn by code. Open source.

See the styles GitHub

Styles

Same character, different eras of animation. Tap a film to play it with sound.

How it works

1

Pick a style

Each style is a small pack: palette, timing, film texture, caption lettering and music genre.

2

Write or record

Type the lines for a free text-to-speech voice, or record your own voice and let the style treat it.

3

Get your reel

Your AI agent animates the scene; it renders to a 1080×1920 MP4 ready for Instagram, TikTok or Shorts.

Use it with Claude Code

Install the plugin, then just ask: “make a 15-second reel in rubber hose style about my coffee shop”.

/plugin marketplace add aleksandrarudenya99/cartoonforge
/plugin install cartoonforge@cartoonforge

Needs Node 22+, FFmpeg and Chrome. A website for non-engineers is on the roadmap.
